text:
elaine: DeployBot scheduled the v2 routing shift for 2026-03-20 22:00Z — staged by region, 10% steps every 5m.
DeployBot: route-change queued: /api/v2 -> /api/v2-header-normalize, regions=[global], step=10%, window=60m. ticket=INF-4021
mason: quick heads-up: our preflight canary (canary-3) shows a 6x increase in 422s for webhook deliveries to partner-pay.
leo: looked at the logs — gateway middleware throws JSON parse errors when Content-Type header is missing. partner-pay sends bare POSTs occasionally.
elaine: ugh. header-normalize strips or rewrites the header in some cases; that explains the sudden 422s.
drew: I can reproduce locally with a minimal curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://gateway.local/api/v2 -d '{"id":1}' --header "Content-Length: 7"
# no Content-Type -> gateway attempts normalize -> downstream chokes
```
leo: confirmed. downstream service (payments-svc) expects explicit application/json and rejects.
elaine: stop the rollout. we should not push region-wide. Can someone pin the EU mobile shard back to v1 routing now? :eyes:
mason: doing pin now. /deploy pin route=mobile-eu target=v1 reason="downstream 422s from header normalize"
DeployBot: PIN applied: route=mobile-eu -> pinned=v1 by mason at 2026-03-20T21:16:xxZ. note=emergency pin due to 422 spike.
sre-bot: alert created in PagerDuty: PD-7891 (partner-pay 422 spike).
drew: temporary mitigation idea: add a non-destructive header-shim that only adds Content-Type if missing (no rewrite). quick patch on gateway-config?
leo: that's safer than full normalize. I can push a hotfix flag: `header_shim.add_if_missing=true` behind the rollout gate.
elaine: prefer config toggle to code change. can we test on canary-3 for 10m?
mason: canary-3 toggle on, 1m smoke pass, then hold. toggled now.
DeployBot: feature-flag update queued: header_shim.add_if_missing=true on canary-3.
leo: smoke logs show the 422s drop to baseline on canary-3. good.
drew: great. plan: 1) maintain mobile-eu pinned to v1 until midnight UTC 2) roll the header_shim to all regions behind the rollout gate 3) update release notes and contact partner-pay with rollback explanation.
elaine: +1. who will update release notes and partner comms?
drew: I can draft a short blurb for release notes and ping partner-pay support.
sre-bot: creating timeline check: we need owner handoff for overnight.
mason: I'll be on call for the next 2 hours and can hand off to amy afterwards (not in thread).
elaine: ops checklist: add entry to release-notes: "v2 header normalization: temporary add-if-missing shim deployed to mitigate missing Content-Type causing 422s; mobile-eu remains pinned to v1 until partner patching confirmed."
drew: also adding deploybot note: rollback criteria - if 422 rate > 3x baseline for 10m in any unpinned region, auto-pin that route.
DeployBot: auto-pin rule created: IF 4xx_spike AND region_unpinned -> pin to previous-stable.
leo: follow-ups: file INF-4022 to track root fix (hard normalize handling + partner compatibility), and include partner-pay in the SLO sync.
elaine: cool. summary for handoff: pinned mobile-eu -> v1, header_shim tested on canary-3, will roll shim globally behind rollout gate tomorrow morning, release notes updated by drew, partner notified. handoff to oncall: mason -> amy.
mason: handing off to amy in ops channel, :white_check_mark:.
drew: thanks all. I'll post the final release-note snippet in #release-notes when it's ready.
elaine: nice quick response team. keeping rollout paused for now.
DeployBot: thread closed by mason (pin applied).
